To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) a system that is simple and effective in the early days will grow organically and become complex, 2) the system will need to evolve to accommodate the growth and the new challenges it creates, and 3) the evolution of the recommender system will be a continuous process that requires constant attention.

the evolution of a Web-scale recommender requires: 1) a simple, high-impact solution to a real-world problem; 2) organic growth of a system with many components; and 3) careful management of the complexity that emerges from this growth.

we can build a Web-scale recommender by: (1) starting with a simple solution that is easy to evaluate and maintain, (2) growing the system organically, and (3) prioritizing the simplest and most effective solution to each new challenge.
